ViewSonic VA24E-H 24" IPS Monitor

​The ViewSonic VA24E-H is a 24-inch monitor that balances performance and efficiency. It features an IPS panel for vibrant color reproduction and a 120Hz refresh rate, making it a strong choice for both office work and casual gaming.

​Display Specifications

  • ​Panel Size: 23.8-inch
  • ​Panel Type: IPS (SuperClear® Technology)
  • ​Resolution: 1920 x 1080 (Full HD)
  • ​Refresh Rate: 120Hz
  • ​Response Time: 1ms (MPRT)
  • ​Brightness: 250 cd/m²
  • ​Contrast Ratio: 1,500:1
  • ​Color Gamut: 109% sRGB
  • ​Viewing Angles: 178° Horizontal / 178° Vertical

​Visual & Eye Care Features

  • ​Variable Refresh Rate: Supports smooth visuals and helps prevent screen tearing.
  • ​ViewMode: Pre-set modes for Game, Movie, Web, Text, and more to adjust color temperature and contrast.
  • ​Flicker-Free Technology: Eliminates backlight flickering to reduce eye fatigue.
  • ​Blue Light Filter: Minimizes harmful blue light for more comfortable long-term viewing.

​Connectivity

  • ​HDMI: 1 x HDMI 1.4
  • ​VGA: 1 x VGA
  • ​Power: External adapter

​Physical Design

  • ​Tilt: -5° to +15°
  • ​VESA Mount: 75 x 75 mm
  • ​Bezel: 3-sided frameless design for an expansive view.
  • ​Finish: Anti-glare coating (3H).

​Key Highlights

  • ​Enhanced Refresh Rate: The 120Hz rate offers a smoother experience compared to traditional 60Hz or 75Hz screens.
  • ​Wide Viewing Angles: IPS technology ensures colors remain accurate even when viewed from the side.
  • ​Modern Aesthetic: The thin-bezel design is ideal for multi-monitor configurations and modern desks.
  • ​Eco-Friendly: Includes an Eco-mode setting to save energy while in use.
